notes.subject: נשמה/לשמה
notes.rationale: Ruatela tok i kam long wanpela as שמם (bagarap): graun i bagarap, na ol i mekim graun bilong laikim tru i kamap bagarap — pasin bilong tok i wok long Tok Pisin tu.

notes.subject: מעבר ומשב
notes.rationale: Hibru i tok 'long man i wokabaut igo na man i kam bek' — i no gat 'man'; KJV i putim 'no man passed through', YLT i rit long pasin bilong Hibru.

notes.subject: ואסערם
notes.rationale: סער em i 'strongpela win i skerim ol' o 'rua' — KJV 'whirlwind', JPS 'scatter with a whirlwind'.

translation: Na mi bai skerim ⟨ol⟩ wantaim strongpela win long namel bilong olgeta ol nesen we ol i no save long ol; na graun i stap nating bihain long ol, ol i no ken wokabaut igo na ol i no ken kam bek; na ol i mekim graun bilong laikim tru i kamap wanpela ples i bagarap.
